in close coordination with inimical elements in Pakistan. The systematic attempts to promote secession of Jammu and 
Kashmir from the territory of India, to undermine the sovereignty of India, to incite the local populace and to promote 
violence have been brought out in the said material/documents. 


278. The Tribunal has also opened the sealed cover (Ex.PW-22/9) containing the statements of the protected 
witnesses (code named as Alpha, John, X45 and X 46) in NIA case no. RC-10/2017/NIA/DLI and perused the said 
statements and re-sealed the same with the seal of the Tribunal. The statements of the said protected witnesses also 
shed light on the modus operandi employed by the JKDFP/Shabir Ahmad Shah to receive funds from across borders 
and indulge in unlawful activities. 


Conclusion 


279. From the elaborate material/evidence placed on record in these proceedings, this Tribunal finds that there is 
ample justification to declare JKDFP as an unlawful association under the UAPA. Moreover, given the nature of 
activities of the association, the Central Government was justified in taking recourse to the proviso to Section 3 (3) of 
the UAPA. As noticed hereinabove, the activities of the concerned association have had a deleterious effect on 
maintenance of law and order in the region of Jammu and Kashmir over the last several decades. The modicum of 
stability that has come about after 2019 (as is evident from the reduced number of unconducive incidents) could not 
have been allowed to be jeopardized on account of continuing activities of the concerned association. 


[भाग 1--खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 73 


280. In the framework of the Indian Constitution and the UAPA, there is no space for an association like the JKDFP 
which openly propagates secessionism, avowedly expresses dis-allegiance to the Constitution of India, and 
undermines the territorial integrity and sovereignty of India. 


281. Thus, this Tribunal having followed the procedure laid down in the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act, 1967 
and its Rules and having independently and objectively appreciated and evaluated the material and evidence on 
record, is of the firm and considered view that there is sufficient cause for declaring JKDFP as an unlawful association 
under Section 3(1) of the UAPA, 1967, vide the notification dated 5" October, 2023. Thus, an order is passed under 
Section 4 (3) of the UAPA, 1967 confirming the declaration made in the notification bearing no. SO 4348(E) 
published in the official gazette on 5" October, 2023 issued under Section 3 (1) of the Unlawful Activities Prevention 
Act, 1967.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 10th April, 2024 


S.O. 1666E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 3931(E) Dated:04/09/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening / Two Laning with Paved Shoulder etc.) Maintenance, 
management and operation of NH931 Pratapgarh - Amethi - Gauriganj - Musafirkhana Road in the stretch of land 
from Km. 0.000 to Km. 22.400 in the district of PRATAPGARH in the state of UTTAR PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Amar Ujala (Hindi)" and 
“Hindustaan Times (English)” both dated 09 sept 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 

And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

S.O. 68I(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.O. 54(E) dated 05.02.2024, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction of Maintenance, management and operation of NH- 
346 in the stretch of land from Km. 0+000 to 96+877 Km. (Chanderi-Pichhore-Dinara Road) (Tehsil-Karera) 
3DAdditional in the district SHIVPURI, in the state MADHYA PRADESH.

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in the “Free Press” and “Satta Sudhar” 
both dated 2 February 2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted 
its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land specified in 
the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares 
that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 10th April, 2024 


S.O. 1692(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 1022 Dated:05/03/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
Belgaum-Hungund-Raichur (EC10) Hyderabad-Panaji NH 748A in the stretch of land from Km. 0.00 to Km. 43.8 
(Special Land Acquisition Officer, NHAI Bagalkot) in the district of BELAGAVI in the state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hindu” and “Samyukta 
karnataka” both dated 07/03/2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 10th April, 2024 


S.O. 1675(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 271 (E) Dated: 18 January 2024, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for the work of rehabilitation and upgradation to two lane with paved 
shoulder configuration from Km. 0+000 to 7+800 Km of NH-727B (Tamkuhiraj to Majhauli Road) in District 
Kushinagar in the state of Uttar Pradesh on EPC mode. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Aaj (Hindi)” and “Times of 
India (English)” both dated 25 January 2024 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And Whereas no objections have been received and whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of 
the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4539(अ) तारीख 46 अक्तूबर 2023, जो भारत के 
राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा राजस्थान राज्य के भरतपुर जिले में 
दिल्ली-बड़ोदरा एक्सप्रेस वे (एनई-4) के कि.मी. 83.3 से कि.मी. 87.2 (उपखण्ड अधिकारी कार्यालय नगर) तक के भूखण्ड 
के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण पेग्डशोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4 लेन का बनाना, आदि) के निर्माण, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के 
लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपबध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमिका अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 44 नवम्बर 
2023 को "दैनिक भास्कर" और तारीख 44 नवम्बर 2023 "a इंण्डियन एक्सप्रेस" में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (॥) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी।

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l0th April, 2024 


9.0. 685(E).—Whereas by the notification number S.O. 4539(E) Dated: l6th October 2023 of 
the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and Highway, published in Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highway 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to 
acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction (widening to 2-lane / 4- 
laning with paved shoulder, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of Delhi - Vadodara Expressway (NE-4) in 
the stretch of land from Km. 83.3 to Km. 87.2 (SDO Office Nagar) in the district of BHARATPUR in the state of 
RAJASTHAN. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Bhaskar ” dated 
.4.2023 and “ The Indian Express " dated ..2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

" को "समाज " और "ओड़िशापोस्ट " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

S.O. 1686(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 3645 Dated:14/08/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH16 in the stretch of land from Km. 98 to Km. 111 (Office of the Tahasildar, Bhandaripokhari, At/Po/PS-

dated 12.12.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 

And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

S.O. 1689(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 5193 Dated:07/12/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-

referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH64ext in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 27.65 (Bathinda) in the district of BATHINDA in the state of 
PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Tribune(English)” and 
“Ajit(punjabi)” both dated 10.01.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 10th April, 2024 


S.O. 1676(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 699 Dated:14/02/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH63 in the stretch of land from Km. 29.1 to Km. 55 (Armoor - Jagitial - Mancherial Section) in the district of 
NIZAMABAD in the state of TELANGANA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hindu” English Daily and 
“Namastey Telangana” Telugu Daily both dated 20th February, 2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said 
Act; 

And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l0th April, 2024 


S.O. 668(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.O. 2483 Dated:06/06/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for "Widening and Strengthening of existing NH-6B from Km 25.500 to Km 
4.000" in connection with the “Preparation of Detailed Project Report for Rehabilitation and Up-gradation to 
2-Lane with Paved Shoulders Configuration of Nandakumar-Contai-Digha-Chandaneshwar Road (0.000 Km. 
to 90.775 Km.) along with Contai Bye-pass (3.30 Km.) (Total Length 94.075 Km.) of NH-6B in the District- 
Purba Medinipur in the State of West Bengal". 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times of India” and 
“Bartaman Patrika” both dated 7.08.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l0th April, 2024 


S.O. 684(E).—Whereas by the notification number S.O. 3722(E) Dated: 2Ist August 2023 of the 
Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and Highway, published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 
Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 
of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction (widening to 2-lane / 4-laning with paved 
shoulder, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of Delhi - Vadodara Expressway (NE-4) in the stretch of land 
from Km. 79.395 to Km. 49 (ADM Office, Alwar) in the district of Alwar in the state of RAJASTHAN.

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Rajasthan Patrika” 
dated ..2023 and “Times of India" dated ..2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.
